nameOrigin: marine crustacean, typically attached to ship bottoms

pokedexEntries.x: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

pokedexEntries.or: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

pokedexEntries.y: Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head’s orders.

pokedexEntries.as: Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head’s orders.

pokedexEntries.sw: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

pokedexEntries.sh: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

pokedexEntries.za: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.
